rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the hand tool, including the long-handled kind used to cut grass or grain.

example.english: The farmer uses a scythe to harvest the rice in the field.
example.traditional: 農夫用鐮刀收割田入面嘅稻米。
example.jyutping: nung4 fu1 jung6 lim4 dou1 sau1 got3 tin4 jap6 min6 ge3 dou6 mai5
